messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: HIGH — embeddings-service 5xx spike in us-west-2 (PD alert PD-2026-4532). Auto-fanout to #incidents and oncall. See: https://pd.redwood/pd/PD-2026-4532

alex: Acked in PD, taking ownership. I'm pinging infra and SRE.

marc: oncall logs look noisy — a bunch of 502/504s from route service -> embeddings. Looks like upstream latency/timeouts. grabbing logs now.

alex: quick health check command I'm running:```bash
curl -sS https://embeddings.us-west-2.api.redwood/v1/health || true
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide
```

marc: logs snippet:
```
2026-07-18T18:22:12Z ERROR request handler request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout
2026-07-18T18:22:13Z WARN kv-cache miss key=prefix:user_42
2026-07-18T18:22:14Z ERROR model client connection reset by peer
```

priya: @alex @marc I'm switching on the per-route circuit breaker to reduce fanout while you triage. Patching ingress rule now.

alex: thanks. I'm also toggling fallback routing to smaller-model-emb-v1 (lower throughput but stable) to reduce error surface.

jess: support here — tagging customer-facing queue. No incoming Zendesk yet, but we'll post to status.redwood if this persists beyond 15m. Any ETA on mitigation?

marc: initial estimate: 10-15m to identify if it's transient network or model process. If model tail latencies, plan is rolling restart + scale + increase request timeout to 30s as temporary.

alex: rolling restart started on embeddings-prod-usw2 (pods: 6 -> 6):```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embeddings-prod --timeout=10m
```

ops-bot: Deploybot: rollout of embeddings-prod triggered by alex at 2026-07-18T18:24:05Z. Monitoring rollout status...

marc: also cleared the local KV prefix cache on one node as a test (didn't reproduce failure after). Might be stale cache causing high latencies for some requests.

priya: ingress circuit breaker lowered concurrency from 600 -> 200 for embeddings route. That should shed load.

jess: posting initial status update: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting inference for embeddings in us-west-2. Engineers are actively mitigating; updates every 15 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: after rolling restart + circuit breaker + fallback routing we're seeing error rate drop from ~7.8% -> 1.1% over last 3m. Latency p50/p95 improved. Still watching.

marc: check metrics: traffic: ~12 rps -> 9 rps (fallback). 5xx count trending down. No customer-facing alerts in last 2m.

priya: I'm handing the incident to priya-oncall-handoff in 25m (I have to step off in 30m). Will keep monitoring until then.

alex: noted. If anything spikes again, escalate to mobile infra (they own the route). Also flagging for post-incident review: investigate KV cache eviction policy + client connection stability.

jess: draft status update queued for 18:45 UTC with current mitigation + ETA for next update.

marc: Confirming: PD alert suppressed for duplicates. We've marked PD-2026-4532 as acknowledged and set severity to degraded.

alex: good. Moving to monitoring mode. If anyone needs to take over: @priya — you'll be primary when I step out.

priya: I'll take over at T+25m. Leaving runbook notes here: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings/5xx-spike — steps performed: toggled circuit breaker, triggered fallback-model, restarted deployment, cleared KV prefix cache.

jess: support status updated at 18:45 UTC. No customer escalations.

marc: follow-up action items for postmortem: 1) root cause of model client resets 2) improve cache eviction instrumentation 3) add delayed auto-restart policy for pods showing connection resets.

alex: thanks team. I'll close the PD incident once we have 15m of stable errors < 1% and confirm no customer impact.

incident-bot: PD incident PD-2026-4532 acknowledged by alex at 2026-07-18T18:25:01Z.

priya: confirming stability window reached at 18:58 UTC — errors hold at ~0.4% for 20m. I will take ownership of follow-ups. Closing observation thread here. :white_check_mark:

jess: thanks everyone — will coordinate customer comms if postmortem finds user-visible root cause.

marc: closing logs/ephemeral traces collection now, saving archive to s3://incidents/PD-2026-4532/trace-archive.tar.gz

alex: closing PD now. Good work.

incident-bot: PD incident PD-2026-4532 resolved and closed by alex at 2026-07-18T18:59:45Z.
